```{r}
# training/validation sets for the model 
encampment_monthly_trn <- encampment_monthly|>
  filter_index(. ~ '2025 Oct')
encampment_monthly_tst <- encampment_monthly|>
  filter_index('2025 Nov' ~ .)

fit <- encampment_monthly_trn |>
  model(
    trend_only   = TSLM(Requests ~ trend()),
    season_only  = TSLM(Requests ~ season()),
    trend_season = TSLM(Requests ~ trend() + season()), # manual model
  )

glance(fit) |>
  select(.model, r_squared, adj_r_squared, AIC, AICc, BIC) |>
  arrange(AICc)
```


```{r}
fc <- fit |> forecast(new_data = encampment_monthly_tst)

accuracy(fc, encampment_monthly) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE) |>
  arrange(RMSE)

fc |>
  filter(.model %in% c("trend_season", "trend_only")) |>
  autoplot(encampment_monthly, level = NULL) +
  labs(title = "TSLM Manual vs. Auto-Selected Forecasts",
       y = "Requests")

augment(fit) |>
  filter(.model %in% c("trend_season", "trend_only")) |>
  autoplot(Requests, color = "gray40") +
  geom_line(aes(y = .fitted, color = .model)) +
  labs(title = "Fitted vs. Actual (Training Data)", y = "Requests")
```
